terms.comment: Useful for reaching far enough to touch a hold.

terms.grammar: attingō with digitō, ablative of means
evidence: Ter. Eun. 4.6.1: atquī sī illam digitō attigerit, oculī illī īlicō ecfodientur (Lewis & Short), s.v. atquī
Traupman p. 102: aliquem ūnō digitō attingere

sources: Lewis & Short: tango
